{{Short description|British statistician (1934–2019)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Terence Michael Frederick Smith''' (18 January 1934 – 7 December 2019)<ref>[https://www.statslife.org.uk/news/4390-fred-smith-1934-2019 Fred Smith 1934-2019]</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|doi=10.1111/rssa.12580|title=T. M. F. Smith, 1934–2019; Harvey Goldstein, 1939–2020; Allan Henry Seheult, 1942–2019;John Francis Bithell, 1939–2020; M. H. A. Davis, 1945–2020|journal=Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series A (Statistics in Society)|year=2020|volume=183|issue=3|pages=1313–1322|doi-access=free}}</ref> was a British [[statistician]] known for his research in [[survey sampling]].

Fred Smith gained his first degree in 1959.

He succeeded Prof [[Maurice Quenouille]]<ref>Statistics: THe Art of Conjecture: T M F Smith</ref> as Professor of Statistics at the [[University of Southampton]] in 1975.<ref>{{cite journal| last=Smith | first=T. M. F.| title = ''Biometrika'' centenary: Sample surveys|journal = [[Biometrika]]|volume = 88| issue = 1 | pages = 167–243 | doi = 10.1093/biomet/88.1.167 | year = 2001 | url = http://biomet.oxfordjournals.org/cgi/content/abstract/88/1/167}}</ref> He received the [[Guy Medal]] in bronze from the [[Royal Statistical Society]] in 1979. In 1983 he was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].<ref>[http://www.amstat.org/awards/fellowslist.cfm View/Search Fellows of the ASA] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160616161612/http://www.amstat.org/awards/fellowslist.cfm |date=16 June 2016 }}, accessed 2016-10-22.</ref>

He was [[President of the Royal Statistical Society|President]] of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] in 1991–1993.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.2307/2982726|title=Populations and Selection: Limitations of Statistics (Presidential address)|first=T. M. F. | last=Smith | journal=[[Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series A]] | volume=156| issue=2| year=1993|pages=144–166|jstor=2982726}}  (Portrait of T. M. F. Smith on page 144) The [[Royal Statistical Society]] lists Smith as the 1991–1993 President in its list of [[presidents of the Royal Statistical Society]], which available on-line: [http://www.rss.org.uk/main.asp?page=1078 List of presidents] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081013180018/http://www.rss.org.uk/main.asp?page=1078 |date=2008-10-13 }}</ref>
